presidents.source_name: National Archives, Constitution of the United States: Amendments 11-27
presidents.note: Background bands mark who was president. They are not an attribution of cause. Presidents do not solely control these metrics. Monthly points use the president in office on the first day of the month. Calendar year points use the president in office on July 1. Fiscal year points use the president in office on October 1, the first day of that fiscal year. A fiscal year runs through the following September 30 and can include two presidents.

todos.dataset: FBI Crime Data Explorer, estimated violent and property crime
todos.reason: Violent crime and property crime charts are omitted. The FBI Crime Data Explorer estimated-crimes file is issued through a signed download, and the api.data.gov Crime Data API requires a key. Set DATA_GOV_API_KEY or FBI_API_KEY to fetch it on a later run. In 2021 the FBI completed the transition from the Summary Reporting System to the National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS). Many agencies did not submit a full year of NIBRS data in 2021. The FBI discusses that break on the Crime Data Explorer. This site does not fill the gap.

eia_us_gen_total.name: Total
eia_us_gen_total.notes: TOTAL.ELETPUS plus TOTAL.SOTEPUS minus TOTAL.SOETPUS when both solar series publish a number for that year. Otherwise TOTAL.ELETPUS. Rounded half up to 3 decimals. The subtraction removes the all-sectors solar already inside TOTAL.ELETPUS so small-scale solar is added once.

eia_us_gen_other.name: Other
eia_us_gen_other.notes: Total minus coal, natural gas, nuclear, conventional hydroelectric, wind, solar, and petroleum in the years those series publish a number. An NA source is not subtracted. Rounded half up to 3 decimals. Pumped storage, wood, waste, geothermal, and other gases stay in this remainder because they are not separate lines on the chart.

charts.title: CPI-U, All items

charts.title: CPI-U, All items, 12-month percent change
charts.notes: Computed from the CPI-U all-items index. Not seasonally adjusted.

charts.title: CPI-U food, shelter, energy, medical care, and education
charts.notes: Each line is rebased to 100 in the first year shared by all five series. Published bases differ. Education is December 1997=100. The others shown here are 1982-84=100.

charts.title: Median sales price of new privately owned houses sold
charts.notes: United States. New houses only. The sales price includes the land. The inflation-adjusted line uses CPI-U, base 1982-84=100.

charts.title: Average hourly earnings of all employees, total private
charts.notes: Not seasonally adjusted. Annual average (period M13). The inflation-adjusted series is the BLS series in 1982-1984 dollars.

charts.title: Average hourly earnings of production and nonsupervisory employees, total private
charts.notes: Not seasonally adjusted. Annual average (period M13). The inflation-adjusted series is the BLS series in 1982-84 dollars.

charts.title: Unemployment rate
charts.notes: Seasonally adjusted, as published by BLS.

charts.title: Median household income
charts.notes: All races. Current dollars and the Census 2025-dollar column. That column uses 2025 C-CPI-U for 2000 to 2025 and R-CPI-U-RS before 2000.

charts.title: Gross domestic product
charts.notes: BEA NIPA annual data. Nominal GDP is current dollars. Real GDP is chained 2017 dollars.

charts.title: Debt to the Penny
charts.notes: Last Debt to the Penny record in each calendar month. Nominal dollars.

charts.title: Monthly receipts, outlays, and deficit or surplus
charts.notes: Monthly Treasury Statement Table 1. The deficit or surplus field equals outlays minus receipts. Nominal dollars.

charts.title: Interest expense on the debt outstanding
charts.notes: Sum of the published monthly component lines. Nominal dollars.

charts.title: Receipts, outlays, and surplus or deficit
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 1.1. Total, in millions of dollars. Single fiscal years only. Budget figures before 1933 use the Administrative Budget.

charts.title: Receipts, outlays, and surplus or deficit as percentages of GDP
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 1.2.

charts.title: Receipts, outlays, and surplus or deficit in constant FY 2017 dollars
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 1.3. Billions of constant FY 2017 dollars.

charts.title: Outlays by function
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 3.1, millions of dollars. Estimate columns are omitted. Labels are the table labels.

charts.title: Outlays by function as percentages of GDP
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 3.1, as percentages of GDP. Estimate columns are omitted.

charts.title: Federal debt at the end of the year
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 7.1. Millions of dollars.

charts.title: Federal debt at the end of the year as a percentage of GDP
charts.notes: OMB Historical Table 7.1. Percent of GDP.

charts.title: Persons obtaining lawful permanent resident status
charts.notes: DHS Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, Table 1. Fiscal years. OHSS rounds cells to the nearest 10. The 1976 row covers 15 months. Shading uses October 1, the same fiscal year rule as the other charts on this site.

charts.title: CBP nationwide encounters
charts.notes: Sum of the Encounter Count column in each CBP nationwide encounters workbook. October of a fiscal year is October of the previous calendar year. Repeated rows in a file stay in the sum.

charts.title: United States: electricity net generation shares by source
charts.notes: Annual percent of U.S. electricity net generation. Coal, natural gas, nuclear, conventional hydroelectric, wind, petroleum, and TOTAL.ELETPUS are all-sectors series in the EIA Monthly Energy Review bulk file. Solar is TOTAL.SOTEPUS (Solar Electricity Net Generation), which includes estimated small-scale solar. The total is TOTAL.ELETPUS plus TOTAL.SOTEPUS minus TOTAL.SOETPUS when both solar series are published for that year, so small-scale solar is included once. Other is that total minus the named sources published for that year. An NA source is omitted and is not subtracted. Shares are rounded half up to 3 decimals and can sum to a number other than 100.

charts.title: Afghanistan: electricity generation per person, kWh
charts.notes: Kilowatthours per person equal EIA electricity net generation in billion kilowatthours, times 1,000,000,000, divided by the World Bank midyear population for that country code and year (SP.POP.TOTL). Rounded half up to the nearest kilowatthour. A year is omitted when either value is missing. Labels mark the earliest year of the maximum value and the latest year. When the series contains a year from 1960 to 1979, that label is 1970 if 1970 is published, otherwise the earliest published year in that span.
